scientific_integrity: Exact all-cardinality theorem proved combinatorially from a hub-membership bijection and cyclic transfer matrix. A standard-library verifier independently enumerates wheel forts at small orders. Integer/linear optimization statements are proved by rim symmetrization, rather than inferred from numerical experiments. The claim is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Publication priority is provisional: unindexed later results might overlap.
Only wheels of the form K_1 join C_n, n>=3, are covered.
The fractional zero-forcing number is the minimal-fort-hypergraph transversal LP, not a different fractional color-change game.
Finite verification does not establish unbounded theorems.
title: The wheel minimal-fort polynomial and its fractional zero-forcing gap
